cases.name: scheduled personal success: derive, advance, rewrap full chain, commit
scheduled shared success: read log under old key, fresh key, distribute, rewrap, complete, commit, re-encrypt log
scheduled conflict with orphaned advance: complete it (distributed share) and stop
scheduled conflict, orphaned advance already complete (rewrap at or below current): stop without rewrapping
scheduled conflict with no rewrap: adopt the completed server epoch (derived key)
scheduled conflict with no rewrap: adopt with a distributed share (no rewrap needed)
removal success: revoke, min-epoch advance, distribute, rewrap, complete, removal entries, notice, commit
removal conflict with orphaned advance: complete it (share), then retry the revocation advance
removal conflict with no rewrap: unrecoverable — error
cases.error: advance conflict without a pending rewrap — cannot proceed (server at epoch 3)

cases.name: removal conflict with stale rewrap (already at or past it): retry the revocation advance
interrupted: complete an orphaned advance with a distributed share (log read under old key)
interrupted derived completion, clean follow-up state: fresh re-rotation follows (D-005)
interrupted derived completion while a follow-up is in flight: defer, then run the deferred pass (D-005)
interrupted derived completion during the deferred pass: give up loudly (D-005 loop bound)
interrupted: rewrap epoch at or below current — no-op
interrupted without a rewrapEpoch in the spec — invalid spec
cases.startError: invalid rotation spec for Interrupted: missing rewrapEpoch

cases.name: interrupted derived completion whose follow-up advance races again: complete the newer orphan (share), then finish
full D-005 loop bound: follow-up, deferred pass, give up — a persistently conflicting server stops after one deferred pass
adopt: resolve the share and commit without a rewrap
adopt: no share — fall back to derivation (legacy chain)
adopt: server epoch at or below current — no-op
adopt without a serverEpoch in the spec — invalid spec
cases.startError: invalid rotation spec for Adopt: missing serverEpoch

cases.name: epoch overflow at u32::MAX — cannot advance
cases.startError: epoch overflow: cannot advance beyond u32::MAX

cases.name: wrong event type for an action — unexpected event
cases.error: unexpected event shareResult for action rewrapDeks

cases.name: removal: advance conflicts, complete orphaned derived advance, follow up, then retry the revocation advance (D-005)
removal: advance conflicts with a stale rewrap twice — bounded retry, error
cases.error: revocation advance failed after retry (server at epoch 2)

cases.name: personal interrupted (no share, no membership log)
failed action inside a D-005 follow-up is contained (pre-port runFreshFollowup semantics)
failed action on a non-follow-up frame aborts the run
crash residue: a pending deferred pass from a prior aborted run runs to completion (D-005)
